$comment: NOTHING ENFORCES THIS YET. No job evaluates a pull request's evidence record:
a pull_request job runs the candidate's own code, so it cannot judge that
candidate. Evaluation belongs to a workflow_run controller pinned to main
Only 'proof:' requirements can be satisfied, by a registered test at head or
by a trusted workflow run of the exact tested merge. 'review:' and
'review-invariant:' requirements are reported and stay unresolved: every
agent writes through one account, so no verdict here can be authenticated.
A requirement matching neither list fails closed.
Any semantic change bumps policyVersion. A record stamped with another
